title: fix(lint): the object_extension publish door refuses an extension field under a label its target already shows, or another field of the same extension shows (field-label-duplicate)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9X2XkBPz2k7zHhv5J4C6j7e)_

Fixes #33644

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none owed — this PR edits `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` (the object extension door paragraph names the rule); `os explain field-label-duplicate` names the door; `skills/objectstack-data` teaches `defineObjectExtension({ extend, fields })` and reusing `owner_id` instead of a second owner field without saying the runtime door is exempt, so the door now gives the verdict the build already gives.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：运行时发布扩展对象（Studio 加字段、`/meta` 写入、MCP/AI 作者）时，也检查"同一对象出现两个同名标签的可见字段"；扩展新加的字段若和目标对象已有字段（含平台的 `owner_id`）同名标签，或同一扩展里两个字段同名标签，发布被拒（422）。
- 为什么改：这条规则原来只拦 `object` 写入，扩展写入不拦，于是扩展可以在别人的对象上加出第二个"负责人"列，列表、卡片、表单里两列同名分不清。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧扩展发布门；只追究这次扩展新造成的冲突，目标对象原有冲突不算它的，扩展把原有冲突变小（拿走其中一个字段）也不算；一方示例（showcase、plugin-auth 各一条扩展）实测零命中。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/lint-duplicate-field-labels.ts`（`duplicateFieldLabelFindings` 的两项门输入）；`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`（`lintDuplicateFieldLabels` 条目加 `object_extension`）；`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts`（新 describe 的十一条用例）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts -t "object_extension door refuses"`，预期 11 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `lintDuplicateFieldLabels` (`field-label-duplicate`) joins the `object_extension` publish door (`runtimeTypes: ['object', 'object_extension']`).
- On that door the rule judges the target as it will be served after the write: the door already hands the target as served without the written package's own stored extension; the rule folds the written entry among the target's other packages' extensions by priority (`ctx.storedObjectExtensions`, the build's fold, so a field two packages tie on is left out as at the build), and reads the served objects back to their authored shape (`stripInjectedSystemColumns`, keyed on `ctx.runtimeWriteType === 'object_extension'`, the argument `validateStackExpressions` gives for the same input), so `owner_id` is named as the platform's column exactly as the build names it.
- The published signature of `lintDuplicateFieldLabels(stack)` is unchanged; the door inputs go through the module-internal `duplicateFieldLabelFindings(stack, options)`, which is not on any package entry.
- The gate's existing differential charges the write only with a clash its entry creates; no gate code changed (one comment in `runtime-gate.ts`). On this door the rule also drops a candidate clash whose fields are a subset of a clash the target already serves before the write: an entry that takes a member out of a three-member clash (relabel, hide, or a priority tie) changes the group's message, so the fingerprint differential alone would charge it for what is left.
- An entry whose own two fields share a label is refused the same way, whether or not the target shows that label (the build already refuses it; the semantic entry, changeset and docs now name this arm).
- The door reads no translation bundle, so the refusal's remedy (semantic entry `replacement`, changeset Migration line, docs) is to give the field a label of its own or reuse the platform column, and on this door the finding's hint drops the build's "(in the translation bundle too …)" clause; `os build` / `os validate` judge a bundle that translates the label apart.
- The before-write snapshot that the shrink rule reads is computed only for the objects the written entry extends (verdicts unchanged).
- `os explain field-label-duplicate` and `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` name the door.
- ADR-0087 semantic entry `object-extension-door-field-label-duplicate-refused` (registered), changeset `.changeset/33644-object-extension-door-label-duplicate.md` (lint + spec minor).

Premise reading: the card's "the TARGET's next `object` save is refused for a clash the extension created" holds at `os build` (the stack's extensions fold onto a declared target), not at the publish door: an `object` write judges the body it sends, which carries no extension fields. The door pin below reads it.

## Tests

New top-level describe in `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts` (the rule's door harness), each a real reading through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules`:

1. ⭐ an extension field labelled 负责人 beside the injected `owner_id` is REFUSED: `where` `object "xl_ticket"`, wire path `objects.xl_ticket.fields`, message names both fields, the label and locale zh-CN, and is byte-identical to the build's finding over the same entry; an extension field labelled like a target field (`Subject`) is refused in the authored pass.
2. unrelated extension writes (`Escalation Level`; `assignee` labelled 处理人; `assignee` labelled 负责人 with `hidden: true`) are not charged.
3. the target's own `object` save after a refused extension write is clean (`lintDuplicateFieldLabels` ran, zero errors).
4. a target that already carries a clash (`phone`/`mobile` both `Phone`, the build reports it) is not charged to an unrelated extension write; an entry that joins the clash is charged (`'fax', 'mobile' and 'phone'`).
5. priority fold: a tie with another package's extension is left out at the build and at the door (with `storedObjectExtensions`); without the stated extensions the door would refuse it; a higher priority (210) is refused.
6. the rule is on both doors.
7. an entry that shrinks a three-member clash the target already serves (`phone`/`mobile`/`fax` all `Phone`; the entry relabels or hides `fax` at priority 210, or ties it at 200) is not charged; a swap that takes `fax` out and puts `headline` under `Phone` is charged.
8. a clashing extension already stored is folded onto the served target by the host; the target's own `object` save then has zero errors, and the build reports the clash on `object "xl_ticket"`.
9. ⭐ an entry whose own `a__c` and `b__c` are both labelled `Region`, on a target that shows no `Region`, is refused; the message names both fields and equals the build's; the same fields under labels of their own publish.
10. the door's hint for a clash only zh-CN shows does not mention a translation bundle; the build's hint over the same entry still does.

Forced test edits (each because the rule now runs on this door):
- `runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts` (2 exact roster pins) and `validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` (3 exact roster pins): `lintDuplicateFieldLabels` inserted in registry order.
- `lint-duplicate-field-labels.test.ts`: the entry's `runtimeTypes` pin reads `['object', 'object_extension']`.
- `runtime-gate.object-formula-cycle.test.ts` "the target's own stored cycle…": the extension field took the helper's shared label `F`, joining the target's `f_x`/`f_y` group (a clash this door now charges); it gets its own label `E`, so the test still asserts zero errors and still means what it meant.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` ([#33153] / [#33494] formula-door describes): the `formula()` helper labelled every field `F`, so the CONTROL entry (`a__c`, `b__c`) served two visible fields under one label and the door refused it (CI Test Core 3/8 on `c51fcc1d`). The helper takes a label; the fields that share an entry or a target get their own (`A`, `B`, `S`). Assertions unchanged. Restoring the old fixture reds the CONTROL case only (1 of 50).

## Acceptance notes

- HotCRM extensions: not measured (outside this session's repository scope).
- The CLI judges an extension's clash only when the stack declares the target; an app extending another package's object is judged at the door only. Unchanged by this PR.

## Verification

All readings at head `4fa9c1cd` (branch point `f81e4b6c`).

<details><summary>Package tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 212 passed (212), Tests 9037 passed (9037). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/migrations`: Test Files 5 passed, Tests 198 passed.
- Consumer `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` (the door's host): Test Files 342 passed, 9 skipped (351); Tests 22926 passed, 45 skipped.
- Extension-door fixture sweep (every test file outside `packages/lint` that publishes or folds an `objectExtensions` entry): runtime 6 files / 135 tests, rest 5 / 55, objectql 8 / 343, cloud-connection 1 / 5, cli `package-export` 1 / 6, all passed. The dogfood files of that kind run in the battery below.
- Consumer `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` (at `315696ed`; round 2 touches no cli input): 421/423 files on the first run; the two reds were `published-subpath-console.pin` and `published-subpath-hook-body.pin` refusing an unbuilt `packages/cli/dist` (prerequisite); after the build both pass (2 files, 29 tests). Integration layer declared to CI.
- Full dogfood battery (Clause-② carries the `(narrowing)` arm), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 467 passed, 3 skipped (470); Tests 3962 passed, 42 skipped (4004).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-off, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob each time)</summary>

- Rule's `runtimeTypes` back to `['object']`: all 7 round-1 cases of the new describe red.
- The stored-extension fold (`objectsAsServed(stack, [])`): only the priority-fold case reds.
- The served-object read-back (`servedObjects` branch disabled): only the owner_id case reds (the finding stops naming `owner_id` as the platform's column, so it no longer equals the build's message).
- The subset drop (`continue` removed): only the shrink case (7) reds.
- The door's hint clause (`authored || extensionWrite` back to `authored`): only the hint case (10) reds, 1 of 55 in the file.
</details>

<details><summary>First-party exposure</summary>

- `examples/app-showcase` entry on `showcase_account` (three fields): build over object + entry + the showcase translation bundle 0 findings; door 0; a planted 负责人 `user` field on the same target is refused (1).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` entry on `sys_sso_provider` (`oidc_client_secret`): build 0, door 0; a planted field under the target's `ID` label is refused (1).
- No other `objectExtensions` entry under `examples/**` or `packages/**` (tooling and tests aside). HotCRM: not measured.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 114 commands. All 114 exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 114 derived, 114 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main --event` over this body: exit 0 (level axis: `no (narrowing)` + `narrowed`, no package graded patch).
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran; `eslint --no-inline-config` over the ten changed `.ts` files exits 0; the repo-wide run is CI's.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (One migration entry; `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide` and the generated-artifact gates exit 0, nothing to commit.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
